children: Advanced Flower Capital authorized a $5.0 million repurchase program and has repurchased 1,060,089 shares to date.
Board approved repurchase program to buy up to $5.0 million of common stock, subject to regulatory and Rule 10b-18 limits.
Program may be executed in the open market and is expected to run until $5.0M repurchased or May 4, 2027, unless amended.
Through Sept. 14, 2026 the company repurchased 1,060,089 shares under the program.
After these repurchases, total shares outstanding are 22,468,755, reducing share count and potentially supporting per-share metrics.
